title: Airport transit – Chicago Transit Authority
claims: CTA Blue Line trains provide direct service to and from O'Hare Airport, with the station in the lower-level concourse connected to Terminals 1, 2 and 3 and via a free airport shuttle train from Terminal 5.
Blue Line trains run 24 hours a day, seven days a week, and take about 40–45 minutes from O'Hare to downtown.
The CTA fare from O'Hare to downtown is $5 or less.
CTA Orange Line trains provide direct service to and from Midway Airport, with the station just east of the terminal and an enclosed walkway.
Orange Line trains take about 20–25 minutes from Midway to downtown and cost $2.50 or less.
Orange Line service does not run overnight, and the N62 Archer bus provides alternate overnight service.
All trains from O'Hare and Midway stations go through downtown.
